scripts.build: cd packages/tui && npm run build && cd ../telemetry && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build && cd ../agent && npm run build && cd ../session-backends/sqlite-node && npm run build && cd ../../protocol && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build && cd ../gui-protocol && npm run build && cd ../gui-host && npm run build && cd ../gui && npm run build
scripts.build:offline: cd packages/tui && npm run build && cd ../telemetry && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build:offline && cd ../agent && npm run build && cd ../session-backends/sqlite-node && npm run build && cd ../../protocol && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build && cd ../gui-protocol && npm run build && cd ../gui-host && npm run build && cd ../gui && npm run build
scripts.check: biome check --error-on-warnings . && npm run check:pinned-deps && npm run check:ts-imports && npm run check:gui-boundaries && npm run check:gui-release && npm run check:shrinkwrap && npm run check:install-lock:coding-agent && tsgo --noEmit && npm --workspace @lystar/code-gui run check && npm run check:browser-smoke
scripts.check:schema: npm run generate:schema && git diff --exit-code -- packages/gui-protocol/generated/gui-protocol.schema.json crates/lystar-protocol/src/generated.rs
scripts.generate:rust-fixtures: node --import tsx packages/gui-protocol/scripts/generate-rust-fixtures.mjs && cargo run -p lystar-protocol --example generate_fixtures && node --import tsx packages/gui-protocol/scripts/check-rust-fixtures.mjs
scripts.check:rust-spike: npm run check:schema && npm run generate:rust-fixtures && git diff --exit-code -- crates/lystar-protocol/tests/fixtures && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && node --test --import tsx packages/tui/test/headless-adapter.test.ts && node --import tsx packages/gui-protocol/scripts/rust-handshake-spike.mjs && cargo build --release -p lystar-tui && bash crates/lystar-tui/tests/pty-terminal-guard.sh && cargo run -q -p lystar-tui --release --example benchmark -- 80 24
scripts.generate:models: npm --prefix packages/ai run generate-models && npm --prefix packages/ai run generate-image-models
scripts.test:deterministic: npm run test:scripts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.version:patch: npm version patch --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:major: npm version major --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run check
